user.title: New preset rule
user.description: Keep these lights preset to a source while they are off, so they turn on directly at the right brightness and color temperature.

data_description.lights: Matter lights or light groups. Groups are expanded to their members.

data_description.adaptive_lighting_switch: Its brightness_pct and color_temp_kelvin attributes are used.

data_description.clear_on_level: A non-null OnLevel makes some bulbs flash to 100% on turn-on. Recommended.

error.no_source_entity: Select at least one source entity.
error.nothing_to_sync: Enable brightness, color temperature, or both.

error.no_source_entity: Select at least one source entity.
error.nothing_to_sync: Enable brightness, color temperature, or both.

apply.name: Apply preset while off
apply.description: Sets brightness and/or color temperature on Matter lights that are off, without turning them on.

apply_if_on.name: Apply if on
apply_if_on.description: For lights that are on, call light.turn_on with these values instead of skipping them.

reset_capabilities.name: Reset capabilities
reset_capabilities.description: Forgets which lights were detected as not supporting presets while off, so they are tested again. Without a target, resets all lights.

unsupported_lights.title: Some lights ignore presets while off

on_level_rewritten.title: OnLevel keeps being rewritten
on_level_rewritten.description: Something else keeps writing OnLevel on lights managed by rule "{rule}": {lights}. A non-null OnLevel brings back the flash on turn-on. Disable automations that write `number.*_on_level` for these lights.
